dataset_name: AgriAgent evaluation set v2 (official labels only)
description: Built by scripts/build_eval_manifest_v2.py. Boxes are copied unchanged from the official annotation files; nothing is hand-drawn. Sugar beet images carry crop and weed boxes; cotton images carry weed boxes only (CottonWeedDet3 does not label cotton), so cotton images are excluded from crop-protection metrics. Labels are boxes, not pixel masks. Replaces eval_manifest_v1, which failed the T3.1 audit.
license: Academic use; see each Kaggle dataset page
selection_rule:
(fixed, so nobody hand-picks easy images):
    sugar beet: of the images that contain at least one crop AND one weed box, sorted in
                natural order, take 30 evenly spaced (np.linspace over the list).
    cotton:     the 8 unique photos matching our old fixtures; CM_29 and CM_40 are byte-identical
                copies of CM_11 and CM_36 in the official dataset itself, so they are left out.
